note: Sound for the start-light countdown. Real F1 starts have no beeps: the lamps are silent and the sound is the engines. Cue positions are in bars (see audio.json); the video draws its lamps from the same numbers. analysis/mix_sfx.py mixes the recording onto the song, its launch on the first dark frame.
